pages.title: About us
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Norwegian Engineering & Consulting (NECON) started with the idea of a company with the best engineers in Norway. If you had challenging projects, you should go to NECON. If you needed the best engineers, NECON was the company to contact. Since the company was founded in 2004, we have done exactly so.
Together with our experienced engineers, we have been solving difficult tasks within the energy, IT, oil and gas, construction, and marine industry. Our specialty is, and always has been, to offer the best competence for the various roles and needs of our clients.
We want our customers to succeed. Therefore, we must find the right competence for your company and project. Our experienced engineers and we always aim to be a partner, not just a supplier. That is why we believe in a proper dialogue before, during, and after delivery. Our managers are mainly engineers with work experience from many of the roles that we offer for our employees.
Our head office is located in Bergen. We provide our services all over Norway, and for international projects as well.
NECON has a long tradition cooperating with colleges and higher education in order to stimulate the interest for science and mathematics especially. The NECON Mathematics award, which we started back in 2008, is a proud sponsorship for us, and we have distributed more than a million NOK in price money to talented students.
NECON wishes to contribute to a healthy lifestyle, sponsoring clubs and associations that promote sound activities for people of all ages, hereby our own employees. NECON Vinterkarusellen, where we are the main sponsor, is a great example.
